jobs.description: Über die PositionAt Grolman, logistics is managed locally across our international entities. As our Global Logistics Strategy & Network Lead, you will establish Grolman's first group-wide logistics strategy and warehouse/freight network roadmap. You will analyse goods flows, redesign logistics structures and unlock added value for customers, suppliers and the business.Your mission• Define and own the long-term strategy and roadmap for Grolman's global warehousing and freight network• Analyse goods flows, logistics costs and service requirements across our B2B distribution network and redesign warehouse and freight networks accordingly• Establish logistics governance, KPI frameworks, reporting standards and benchmarking across international entities• Build and manage long-term strategic partnerships with logistics service providers across Central Europe• Lead international optimisation and transformation initiatives from concept to implementation, automating processes, reducing costs and improving transparency and service performance• Develop logistics services that create added value for customers and suppliers and drive sustainable logistics concepts, including CO₂ reporting and emissions-reduction initiativesYour profile• Proven track record in designing, building or transforming international warehouse and freight networks, including goods-flow analysis and network optimisation• Background in B2B distribution; chemicals, industrial distribution or similarly complex supply chains are a strong plus• Experience building long-term partnerships with logistics service providers across Central Europe• Experience establishing logistics governance, KPI frameworks and performance management across multiple entities• Strategic and hands-on: you lead change and influence stakeholders across decentralised international organisations without formal authority• Excellent written and spoken English; Power BI and logistics network modelling tools; passion for balancing service, cost efficiency, resilience and sustainabilityWhy us?Why us?We are shaping the future of circular innovation with the vision:“We sell chemicals to save the planet.”You can expect a friendly, self-organized, and international working environment with flat hierarchies and teams that take full ownership and responsibility. We believe that commitment and enjoyment at work lead to outstanding performance. Trust, mutual respect, and loyalty form the foundation of our collaboration.We communicate openly, act authentically, and continuously reinvent ourselves – optimistically, entrepreneurially, and always on equal footing. Let’s Grow New together.Benefits• Flexibility in working hours and location• Internal coaching & training• Collaboration in a Self-Organised Environment• Direct impact on the Group’s sustainability and circularity strategy• Remote-based in any EU country where Grolman Group operatesSalary information in line with EU Pay Transparency requirements: Austria: Gross annual base salary of €68,000–€80,000, with readiness to pay above the applicable collective-agreement minimumItaly: Gross annual base salary of €55,000–€68,000.Other eligible EU countries: The applicable salary range will be shared before the first interview.About usWe are an international specialty chemicals distribution company that has been privately owned and managed by the fifth generation of the Grolman family since 1855. The key to our success has always been our strong commitment and dedication to building an efficient, customer-oriented organization in which the needs of our customers are the main driving force.Our vision is: “We want to sell chemicals to save the planet.” For us, this means promoting innovation towards a circular economy. We achieve this through a strong focus on close personal relationships and the development of our own employees.

In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for severalPostdocs (2 years) (m,f,x)The Cluster of Excellence "CASA: Securing the Digital Society" is funded by DFG for the years 2026-2032 with approximately 53 million euros. CASA aims to strengthen the resilience of our digital society. The emergence of disruptive technologies in recent years, especially artificial intelligence and quantum computers, has caused substantial new challenges for cybersecurity research. In the second funding phase, CASA will specifically address these challenges. Thematic priorities include the security of quantum technologies, protection against Al-based disinformation and societal polarization, and new approaches to defending against ransomware. In addition to technical questions, it also investigates the interaction of human behavior and cybersecurity. Research at CASA, which is based at the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security, follows a strongly interdisciplinary approach. Researchers from the fields of computerscience, cryptography, electrical engineering, mathematics, and psychology work together in an unique constellation in Europe. This holistic approach is unparalleled and holds the potential for scientific breakthroughs. Ruhr-University Bochum (RUB) and its Faculty of Computer Science offer an excellent environment for aspiring young researchers. 20 years ago, the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security (HGI) was founded here. lt is now one of Europe's most prestigious institutions for basic computer security research. The HGI maintains extensive networks with leading research institutions worldwide and with media and industry. Moreover, it has produced numerous successful security startups. The pioneering work of the HGI forms the basis for the Cluster of Excellence CASA.Scope: full-timeDuration: fixed-term, 2 yearsStart: at the earliest possible dateApply by:  2026-11-09Your tasks:- Our goal is to attract postdoctoral researchers and enable them to conducttheir research with the mentorship of a PI. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day You lead the commodity agenda for electrical insulation and copper materials for Large Generator products. From your base in Bucharest or Mülheim, you orchestrate the commodity circle, align closely with Engineering, Quality, and Operations, and turn market insight into resilient sourcing strategies and supplier agreements that secure capacity, reduce risk, and deliver measurable cost and sustainability impact. How You’ll Make an Impact* Developing and implementing the Commodity Strategy for Large Generator portfolio in alignment with Global Commodity Strategy for Electrical Insulation components e.g. Insulating Tapes (Mica, OCP, ICP etc.), Rigid Components like Prepreg, Rings, EPGx (sheets and machined profiles), Ropes, Tubes and Laminates. Additionally responsible for commodity management of Copper based material like Copper Flats, Insulated Flat Wires, Sheets, Profiles etc. in machined form. * Lead the Commodity Circle and drive the end to end strategic procurement cycle: market analysis & scouting, should cost insights, negotiation planning, eSourcing events, award proposals, and sourcing board preparations. * Secure capacity and supply resilience via frame contracts, price lists, and multi sourcing strategies; identify and mitigate risks (e.g., tariff exposure, single source, capacity constraints) and ensure continuity for critical Large Generator demand. * Deliver measurable value (CNI/savings, total cost improvements, inventory and cash objectives) and maintain transparent KPIs and spend dashboards for your area. * Drive early supplier involvement with Engineering and SQD to accelerate NPI/continuous improvement, quality robustness, and manufacturability—translating field and supply market feedback into actionable design-to-value measures. * Manage strategic supplier relationships: performance reviews, joint improvement roadmaps, and executive governance with top suppliers in EMEA and beyond. What You Bring* Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain/Procurement, or Business—plus professional experience in direct material commodity management or category management in an industrial/manufacturing setting. * Familiarity with generator insulation systems and copper products (e.g., profiles, bars, wire, sheet) or adjacent electrical materials. Experience turning technical specs into sourcing strategies is key. * Supplier market analysis & scouting, cost modeling/should cost, competitive tendering, fact based negotiations, contracting (frame agreements/price lists), and risk management. * Proven ability to lead cross functional commodity teams (Commodity Circle) and influence at multiple levels, internally and at suppliers. * Proficiency with ERP/MRP and eSourcing platforms; comfort with KPI dashboards and data driven decisions. (Experience within Siemens Energy procurement frameworks is a plus.) * Professional fluency in English & German required for stakeholder and supplier interactions; Willingness to travel (~10–20%) for supplier visits and cross site collaboration.About the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us.
